name: @plimsoll/backing
description: The issuer's real backing for a Plimsoll note: ERC-4626 positions on Base, with status, deposit and withdraw commands that simulate unless told to send.

scripts.status: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js status
scripts.deposit: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js deposit
scripts.withdraw: npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js withdraw
